description: ResultSet.started_at is declared format: date-time, i.e. an RFC 3339 date-time: full-date "T" full-time with seconds and a mandatory offset (Z or +hh:mm/-hh:mm). A date-only value like "2026-09-29" is valid ISO 8601 but is NOT an RFC 3339 date-time, so it cannot be ordered against other timestamps without guessing a time and a time zone. A conformance implementation MUST REJECT this document (reference validators: INVALID_DATE_TIME). Note that JSON Schema treats format as an annotation unless format assertion is enabled; a JSON-Schema-based implementation must enable it for date-time to agree with this fixture.
